sources.snippet: Supported Tasks This resource is intended for validating training data loading, debugging the training workflow, and performing minimal data sanity checks for the OneScience/ProteinMPNN model. Model inference generally does not require this training dataset.

sources.title: OneScience-Group/ProteinMPNN · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Introduction ProteinMPNN is a protein sequence design model based on a Message Passing Neural Network. Given a protein backbone structure, it can efficiently generate highly expressible and foldable amino acid sequences.
